vals: On the Calculation tab, key in data in all relevant yellow cells
Note 1: in the "Application Fee" field in cell C13, key in the amount the property charges to residents as an application fee
Note 2: in cell C14, select the state the property is located in (this drives late fee calculations)
If a property has a maximum management fee, override the 9,999,999 in cell J8 with the maximum. Otherwise, leave the 9,999,999 as-is so the calculations work correctly.
If the property has retail, complete yellow cells in rows 48-54 on the Calculation tab
If the property has asset management fees, complete the yellow cells in rows 59-63 on the Calculation tab
Verify the prior month's data was transferred to the "Annual" tab (if not first month).  Complete step 7 below before proceeding if data still needs to be transferred
Select the Current Period in cell C9 on the Calculation tab
Run the Yardi Income Statement report in excel for the current month and drop into the Income Statement tab

Run the Yardi "Charge Register" Report using the exact parameters shown in the screenshot below (Note: Only run for the late fee charge code). Copy ONLY columns A-P and paste into cell A1 of the Late Fees tab
Make sure each ALL Inclusive Draft has been posted for the current month before proceeding.

Update the yellow fields in the  Adjustments section of the Calculation tab.  Only change yellow cells.  If cells are white, data will be pulled in from a report or a different cell.  The description you type in Column F will be displayed
on the report so be sure to check your spelling.

Note: For the Annual Summary to work correctly, any descriptions you enter in the manual adjustment section should remain the entire year, i.e. if you list something in column F in January, it needs to stay there all year.
If the property has Retail, run the Income Statement report for the retail property code and paste into the Retail tab

Hit the "Transfer to Annual Summary" button.  Note: the macro copies and pastes all data in column G on the calculation tab and pastes it into the next blank column on the Annual tab.  If something changes after you run the macro and you need to update the annual tab;

go to the annual tab, highlight the entire column for the current month - click the delete button on your keyboard to clear all data in the column.  You can then hit the "Transfer to Annual Summary" button on the calculation tab to transfer the updated info to the annual tab.
**This only works to update the current month.
To prorate the monthly fee, simply type the number of days that we should collect a fee for over "No" in cell E42
If the property does not have Retail or Asset Management Fees, you can click the minus sign next to either section on both the Calculation tab and the Annual tab to hide
To print all pages required by the client in one PDF, highlight the tabs you want to print and make sure your print setting is set to "Print Active Sheets".
For best print quality, go to Page Setup, and under the 'Print Quality' drop down menu, select the highest number available.
